references.text: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads and saying
They twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They put a staff in his right hand. Then they knelt down in front of him and mocked him, saying, "Hail, king of the Jews!"
They dressed him in a purple robe, twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on him. And they began to greet him, saying, "Hail, king of the Jews!"
The Jews answered him, "We have a law, and according to that law he must die, because he has made himself the Son of God."
